notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped directed-interaction TAR/NMR surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped directed-interaction delivery across independent time advance requests while preserving standard ordering, retraction, callback, and lifecycle behavior, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped directed-interaction, retraction, and TAR/NMR services with FederateAmbassador directed-delivery and time-advance callbacks
